_comment: EAS is deployed via the OP Stack predeploy address on Base — same address for the EAS contract and the SchemaRegistry, on both Base mainnet and Base Sepolia. schemaUID is populated by scripts/register-eas-schema.js (one-time, irreversible per network) and is null until that script has been run.

base_mainnet.schema: string receiptId,bytes32 receiptHash,string verificationType,uint8 score,string ipfsUri

base_sepolia.schema: string receiptId,bytes32 receiptHash,string verificationType,uint8 score,string ipfsUri
